name: gully-adda
description: Gully Adda: 90s Retro Games - monorepo (Expo app, shared engine, Firebase backend)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @gully/engine && npm run test -w functions
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build -w functions && (cp -n functions/.secret.local.example functions/.secret.local || true) && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-gully-adda "npm run test:emulator -w functions"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && (cp -n functions/.secret.local.example functions/.secret.local || true) && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-gully-adda
scripts.store:screenshots: cd apps/mobile && npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-web && cd ../.. && node store/scripts/screenshots.mjs
